## TASK-026 - Update current delivery inventories and distribute neutral Template assets

Complete reusable package contracts/manifest/notices/docs and neutral starter mappings, then use the Template update owner to distribute the exact reviewed release files. Add the current explorer capability/compatibility inventory without rewriting historical initializer editions, and finish shipping operational documentation before final cutover and provenance analysis.

| Dependencies | TASK-025 |

### Risks

- Existing watcher may distribute before a manual step; coordinate current owner and complete source package, preserve its exact receipt/history rather than racing writers.

### Acceptance criteria

- Source collection owns every reusable addition/removal; neutral Template contains runtime assets, lock/build identity/notices and neutral identity/purpose/category configuration without claiming it is a specialized running project.
- No hard-coded depot identity, fixtures/runtime/model/session state, history edits, unrelated restructuring or direct mapped-Template source edits occur.
- Current explorer inventory handles legacy workbench asset coupling explicitly. Historical v9 receipt/resource meaning and earlier-edition snapshots remain intact; old assets are not deleted merely to satisfy new setup tests.
- All shipping assets survive existing dist/build exclusions, and missing/corrupt manifests fail package validation. Operational docs name actual build/launch/config/compatibility/error/rollback routes before cutover.

### Planned verification

- Run .venv/bin/python tools/template_update.py check; inspect exact source/destination/deletion/neutrality list and any customized conflicts before authorized apply.
- Run the registered Template contract suite and inspect installed bundle/read package completeness; retain updater receipt and fresh current check.
- Run affected current initializer and Template contract tests for current explorer completeness, historical receipt preservation, missing assets/notices and neutral optional-profile state.
- Reopen Template output and compare exact manifest digests; if watcher readiness is relied on, inspect a fresh successful check from its current PID.

### Risks

- If root adoption authority is unavailable, retain an explicit incomplete release gate; do not mark root behavior verified.

### Acceptance criteria

- Root reader is explicitly launchable while workbench normal-entry cutover remains gated; source/installed/Template files match the reviewed manifest.
- AT-31 demonstrates independent IDs/routes/caches/preferences/sources/sessions with shared-label different meanings; no product registration or scanning is added.
- Neutral Template has no invented depot identity: unspecialized startup reports configuration need, or a documented disposable specialization demonstrates reading. Record which behavior was observed; keep a different-namespace fixture with a shared label/different meaning for isolation.

### Planned verification

- Run actual production launch/read/search/process/map/List/source checks in the root and documented neutral-Template context (explicit configuration-needed behavior or disposable specialization), plus the second namespace fixture.
- Attempt cross-context session/cursor/source reuse and inspect root final diff, protected files and updater state.
- Record an individual observed result and exact evidence locator for each scenario: AT-31. Aggregate suite success does not replace per-scenario evidence.
